title: Retain one-window browser source prefetch
question: Can the browser refill the next source window while the engine consumes the current one?
summary: One 256 KiB outstanding source read removed 1.34 to 3.40 seconds from three measured jobs, with effectively flat browser CPU. Retain as a benchmark candidate.

workloads: File-backed Chromium streaming and partition to OPFS on WSL.

validation.summary: Twelve timed comparisons verified records, output caps and cleanup. A separate injected rejection successfully fell back to synchronous reading.

limitations: One WSL host, Chromium and OPFS. The prototype JS slot is outside WASI working reservations.
exclusions: Production buffer ownership, in-flight cancellation qualifications and default selection.
reopen_when: Integrate a browser buffer limit and qualify cancellation with one source read outstanding.
